remarks: Discover the multiple possibilities that this versatile home offers! Ideal for owner-occupants or investors; the layout provides opportunity for multi-generational living, a private in-law suite, or the potential to rent the upper or lower level for additional income. In addition to the opportunity with the existing layout, there is a bonus room on the second floor, and the basement also offers a future investment opportunity.  With limited work, it would allow for additional living/rental space. Recent updates include brand new flooring throughout both floors, a new kitchen island, bathroom vanity, stove, and central air. Outside is as inviting as the inside with a covered porch in the front and a patio and fenced yard in the back. The location is a less than 10-minute walk away from the bus stop, several shops, and restaurants, including Wegmans, Walmart, Starbucks, 7 Brew Coffee, and more! Whether you are looking for an inviting single-family home, to offset your mortgage or expand your investment portfolio, this property offers amazing potential!   Offers will be reviewed as they are received.
